title: Feature request: "Insulin curve" setting in "Low prediction values"
symptom: The user requests a feature to configure the insulin curve (e.g., start, peak, main acting, tail) for different ultra-short-acting insulins, as the current graph appears to use a linear curve.
fix: The issue was closed as covered by PR #1388, which presumably implements the requested feature. The maintainer recommends waiting for the PR to be merged into master.
evidence_quote: I'm closing this issue because I believe it is fully covered by #1388.
